parsed.attack: Anyone who feels this pain is already inside the five-year window, and the wedge explicitly starts from signup rather than a historical import, so the product is useless to everyone with urgency and asks everyone else to document against an event they are actively in denial about - pre-need purchasing for eventual nursing-home care is the hardest sale in consumer finance for exactly that reason. The lookback is also satisfied from bank and institutional records that already exist and that a caseworker requests directly; what fails an application is unexplained transfers and gifts, which are visible in those statements whether or not the family kept a ledger. The spiral binder is a stated inconvenience, not a documented failure anyone has paid to avoid.
parsed.strongest_defence: Elder law attorneys tell families to begin documenting at the planning conversation, five years before any application, which is a real professional moment carrying an authoritative instruction; the product is sold at that referral rather than to a family in crisis, and the value is per-line categorisation and payer attribution that raw bank statements do not carry.
parsed.verdict_reason: Felt urgency arrives only once a forward-only record can no longer help, leaving a professionally referred planning purchase rather than consumer demand.
